data.name: Maulvi
data.gender_notes: Maulvi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A term used to describe a religious scholar or teacher in Islam. The name Maulvi carries the meaning “Master of Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maulvi usually hope their child will grow to embody master of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Quran states in Surah Al-An'am: 'Are those who know equal to those who do not know?' (39)
data.etymology: Maulvi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Master of Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maulvi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مولوی
in_arabic.long_meaning: مولوی هو رجل دين إسلامي يعتبر مرشدًا روحيًا ومعلمًا دينيًا، ويعود أصل الكلمة إلى الفارسية، ويشير إلى الشخص الذي يعتبر مرشداً أو معلماً للناس في الأمور الدينية

in_urdu.name: مولوی
in_urdu.long_meaning: مولوی ایک اسلامی धर्म کا عالم ہے جو روحانی مرشد اور مذہبی استاد کے طور پر کام کرتا ہے، یہ اصطلاح فارسی سے ماخوذ ہے اور مذہبی معاملات میں لوگوں کے لئے مرشد یا استاد کے معنی میں ہے

in_hindi.name: मौलवी
in_hindi.long_meaning: मौलवी एक इस्लामिक धर्म का विद्वान होता है जो आध्यात्मिक मार्गदर्शक और धार्मिक शिक्षक के रूप में कार्य करता है, यह शब्द फारसी से लिया गया है और धार्मिक मामलों में लोगों के लिए मार्गदर्शक या शिक्षक के अर्थ में है

in_pashto.name: مولوی
in_pashto.long_meaning: مولوی د اسلام د دین پوه دی چې د روحاني مرشد او دینی ښوونکي په توګه کار کوي، دا اصطلاح له پارسي څخه اخیستل شوی ده او د دیني چارو کې د مرشد یا ښوونکي په معنا کې دی

data.cultural_impact: In the Islamic world, the title "Maulvi" (مولوی) is a respected title given to religious scholars, teachers, and spiritual leaders in the Muslim community, often considered as the Muslim equivalent of a Christian priest or a Jewish rabbi. Their teachings and guidance are sought after by many, and they play an essential role in preserving and passing down Islamic traditions and knowledge from generation to generation.
data.spiritual_significance: The title "Maulvi" carries a deep spiritual significance in Islam as it represents the knowledge and wisdom one obtains through years of dedicated study and practice. The Maulvi serves as a spiritual guide, providing counsel and answers to the religious and ethical questions of the community. Through their teachings and guidance, they help cultivate a deeply spiritual connection to God and support the community's growth in faith.

historical_references.reference: Maulvi was a title given to Islamic scholars and religious leaders in South Asia during the British colonial period.
historical_references.context: British colonial rule in South Asia

trends: Maulvi is still used as a title for Islamic scholars and religious leaders in South Asia.
The term has also been used in a derogatory manner to refer to extremist Islamic leaders.
